mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon_key, c.sort_order, c.active, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.category_id = c.id) AS product_count FROM category c ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id
SELECT id, name, icon_key, sort_order, active, created_at, updated_at FROM category WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category (name, icon_key, sort_order, active) VALUES (#{name}, #{iconKey}, #{sortOrder}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE category SET name = #{name}, icon_key = #{iconKey}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE category_id = #{id}
